Questions

Good to know

How many pieces should I choose?

For children aged 3 to 5, 30 big pieces is plenty. Most children from 6 enjoy 110 pieces, and 252 pieces makes a lovely evening for older children and families. 500 and 1,000 pieces are for keen puzzlers. Each size shows the finished size in centimetres, so you can check it fits your table.

What makes a good photo for a puzzle?

A sharp, well-lit photo taken on a modern phone works well. Faces should be clear and not too small. For the cartoon looks and backdrops, a photo of people standing or sitting together is best. Busy, detailed pictures make the most fun puzzles, and big areas of plain sky make the hardest.

What are the looks?

You can keep your photo as it is, or we draw it in one of our cartoon styles: Cartoon Splash, Painted Splash, Watercolour, Comic Pop or Storybook. They're the same styles families choose for our Family Board Books.

How do backdrops work?

We draw your family into a new scene, such as the streets of Paris, a sunny beach, snowy mountains, a jungle or outer space. You see a free preview first and can try another backdrop before you order.

Cardboard or wood?

Cardboard puzzles have a glossy photo finish, come in a gift tin with your picture on the lid, and are made in the UK in a few days. Wooden puzzles are laser cut from 3 mm wood, come in a keepsake box and last for years. They cost a little more and take 2 to 4 weeks to arrive.

Can you send it straight to the person it's for?

Yes. Just enter their address at checkout. We never put prices in the parcel.

Where are my photos stored?

In private, encrypted storage in the European Union, in Cloudflare's EU data centres. Before a photo leaves your phone or computer, we shrink it and remove hidden details such as where it was taken. Your photos are never published.

How long do you keep my photos?

Free previews are deleted after 14 days if you don't order. Original photos are deleted once your puzzle is printed. You can delete everything yourself at any time. We never use your photos for advertising or to train AI.

Where do you deliver?

The UK and Europe. We'll confirm delivery times and costs when ordering opens.
